nodes.label: Kindergarten Qualitative MTSS Mode
nodes.rationale: Kindergarten MTSS is qualitative (no scores) because scoring is inappropriate at this age; uses mode:'qualitative' on MentorAssignment plus a Learning-Story-with-Signal check-in format (CORN + emerging/developing/consistent). Explicitly must not be applied to other grade levels.

nodes.label: Grade 7 Helix Intervention & Check-in Workflow
nodes.rationale: Design intent: cap Pak Abu at 2 subjects (SEL+Behavior) while other teachers get 1, and require 3 timestamped check-ins (14d ago baseline, 7d ago mid-point, today) per intervention so progress trend and teacher workload distribution can both be validated end-to-end (seed -> Jest -> Cypress).

nodes.label: 200-Line File Size Limit Rule
nodes.rationale: Files capped at 200 lines (further split by category) to prevent performance-heavy 'monster' files and keep components modular for load-time and maintainability.

nodes.label: Lazy Loading / Code Splitting Guideline
nodes.rationale: Prioritize lazy loading and code splitting to reduce initial bundle size and GPU usage while preserving visual fidelity.

nodes.label: Classroom/Subject System (P0 Foundation)
nodes.rationale: Chosen as P0 foundation because a hierarchical Grade > Class > Subject structure underlies every other planned feature (scheduling, portfolios, check-ins), enabling scalable grade-by-grade rollout.

nodes.label: Emotional Check-in Dashboard (Mandatory 'Aha Moment' Feature)
nodes.rationale: Made mandatory and prioritized as the primary adoption driver ('aha moment') because it directly targets FGD pain points and is expected to produce the fastest visible win for teacher/student engagement.
